title: A royal name need not name the builder
position: Columns throughout the hall; exact examples require numbered-column matching.
question: Why are there so many repeated royal ovals?
observation: Later rulers inserted inscriptions into older decoration.
explanation: The project distinguishes additions in blank space from replacements of earlier names. Those are different acts, not a single story of erasure.
lookFor: Compare the placement of name bands with the surrounding ritual scenes.
Ask whether a name is added, recut or part of the original scene.

claims.text: Ramesses IV added repeated name bands; some of his cartouches were subsequently changed for Ramesses VI.

citations.locator: Marginal Decoration: paragraphs on Ramesses IV and Ramesses VI

uncertainties: Do not assign a specific cartouche to a king from depth or size alone.
Match an edition and photograph before transcription.
